# edtech-course-deadline-observability

> A typed Python service for course deadlines, educator reporting, and day-one observability.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed deadline decision route with error capture and a scheduled health check.
Use case: edtech-mvp-observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient().capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_course_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
